message.text:
q19.

ConnectRPC — `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go` (with the per-RPC wrapper methods in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go`)
gRPC-Gateway REST/JSON — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`

For ConnectRPC, `ConnectServiceHandler` embeds `*APIV1Service` and `RegisterConnectHandlers` mounts the generated handler on the mux:

```40:40:server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go
		wrap(apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler(s, opts...)),
```

The thin per-method adapters that unwrap `connect.Request`/rewrap `connect.Response` and delegate to `APIV1Service` live under the `// MemoService` section of `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` (starting line 304).

For the REST gateway, the same `APIV1Service` value is registered against a `runtime.ServeMux`:

```108:110:server/router/api/v1/v1.go
	if err := v1pb.RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer(ctx, gwMux, s); err != nil {
		return err
	}
```

That mux is then mounted on the Echo server at `/api/v1/*` and `/file/*` (lines 128–129), translating the `google.api.http` annotations in `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` into HTTP routes. Both protocols share one implementation: `APIV1Service` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`.
